gameDescriptionHtml:
Take over the gas station and convenience store at a roadside rest area and expand by purchasing new businesses. Manage a living world shaped by dynamic economy and random events. Upgrade your facilities, satisfy your customers, and play solo or with friends.

Game Features

  • MANAGE BUSINESSES WITH FRIENDS (CO-OP) – Rest Area Simulator can be enjoyed solo or with up to 4 friends. Share tasks, manage different businesses, and tackle crises together. Good coordination will take your operations to the next level!
  • DYNAMIC SYSTEMS A LIVING WORLD – Operate your facility in various weather conditions such as clear skies, fog, and storms. Your facility opens in the morning, visitors arrive throughout the day, shop, and interact with the environment. At the end of the day, businesses close, and you prepare for the next. Visitors arrive by car or metro, walk around the rest area, sit on benches, chat, or shop. Each visitor follows their own unique routine.
  • REPUTATION TAKES EFFORT – Operate your facility in various weather conditions such as clear skies, fog, and storms. Your facility opens in the morning, visitors arrive throughout the day, shop, and interact with the environment. At the end of the day, businesses close, and you prepare for the next. Visitors arrive by car or metro, walk around the rest area, sit on benches, chat, or shop. Each visitor follows their own unique routine.
  • ECONOMY IS MORE THAN JUST NUMBERS – Clean the floors and walls, collect trash, fix breakdowns, don’t keep customers waiting too long, and keep each business’s reputation score high. High-reputation businesses attract more customers.
  • EXPAND LEVEL UP, OPTIMIZE – Product purchase prices change depending on the buying and selling activity at your facility. A product bought in bulk may become more expensive or yield less profit. You must strategically manage both your business and the economy.
  • ILLICIT PROFIT SYSTEM – Gain experience through tasks like customer service, cleaning, and product management to level up. Leveling up allows you to acquire sales licenses for new products and purchase new businesses like supermarkets and car washes. If the workload is too much, hire staff and take it easy. Each business has its own unique upgrades: Buy new pumps, order security cameras, invest in a generator to stay open even during bad weather.
  • EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED – Not every profit has to be honest. With the Illicit Profit System, you can take risks to earn more money: Watering down fuel, Charging customers unfairly, Give more fuel than requested. But beware: random inspections and customer reactions may turn those extra profits into big fines or reputation loss. Will you play it safe, or gamble for quick cash?
